productModel.tokenToGrow: projectToken — the asset the founder wants the program to grow liquidity for
productModel.quoteAsset: pair quote asset used when matching buys / adding LP (Factory quote policy)
productModel.tokenReserve: amount of projectToken deposited via depositBudget — not a WBNB budget

whyReserveIsProjectToken: Program.depositBudget pulls projectToken. The reserve funds the builder by selling / matching the project token into quote and minting LP. Calling it a WBNB budget inverted roles.
whyQuoteIsSeparate: Quote Asset selects the market side of the Melega pair (WBNB enabled on Factory). It is not deposited as the Token Reserve; the program acquires quote from market activity against the reserve.

expectedFee.note: Fee schedule unchanged; levied on program success path from program accounting — not a WBNB budget fee.

supersededWording.problem: Documented a WBNB Liquidity Budget while depositBudget always pulls projectToken and Factory enables WBNB as quote only.

ethCallCreateProgramSmoke.note: Static eth_call only — no Founder signature / no deposit / no activate
